sets.surface: road asphalt, aged, with long cracks
sets.use: Jamaica Ave travel and parking lanes. The cracks are distinctive: offset and rotate per road segment, or blend with TS_Asphalt_ScanWorn through a mask, so the repeat does not show.
sets.colour: Neutral mid grey with a slight green cast: right for sun-greyed New York asphalt. Darken about 10 % under the El (soot, drip lines).

sets.use: Blend partner for TS_Asphalt_ScanCracked on the avenue (wheel paths, crack-free stretches); rear service lane.
sets.colour: Warm brown-grey: pull the hue toward neutral (less red) for New York.

sets.use: The 'patched' road variant: utility-cut patches and the repaved strip on Jamaica Ave. Mask it over TS_Asphalt_ScanCracked with hard-edged rectangles and a tar-seal border; no scan with real patch seams exists on Poly Haven.
sets.colour: Near black, slightly warm: correct for hot-mix under a year old. Lift toward dark grey for older patches.

sets.use: Parking lot surface; parking lanes and the kerb-side strip of the avenue.
sets.colour: Dark with brown stones: neutralise slightly.

sets.use: The Cage ball court (under the painted lines and colour coat) and the oldest part of the parking lot.
sets.colour: Light neutral grey. A court colour coat (green, red) is a tint in the material, not in the map.

sets.surface: asphalt from the air, 30 m across: macro variation
sets.use: Macro layer for the avenue and the lot: tyre arcs, long cracks and stains at 30 m scale, multiplied over the detail sets to break up tiling. Too coarse to use alone up close.
sets.colour: Bluish (sky reflection in the capture): desaturate and use as a luminance multiplier.

sets.use: Sidewalk flags on both sides of Jamaica Ave. The 5 ft (1.524 m) flag joints are not in the scan: cut them in geometry or decals. Turn the set so the broom lines run kerb to building line.
sets.colour: Brown-olive cast: grade to light warm grey (sunlit New York sidewalk, albedo about 0.35 to 0.45); gum spots and stains by decal.
